name: live-v17-wi-readback
objective: v2.3 replan V17 on a real SillyTavern (no model needed: the writes under test are lorebook toggles). ST's `_save` posts `/api/worldinfo/edit` and never reads the answer (world-info.js:4151), so a save the server refuses resolves like a kept one. A checkpoint's world_info toggle now reads the server's copy back. Entering The Quay with a 500 injected on that route in the page: the server still holds the entry OFF, the journal says the world_info effect could not be applied and names the entry, and the page's copy of the book is evicted so it agrees with the server. The next apply (The Quay entered again: since v2.6 plan 04 C4, e04783c2, an author jump stages from its target alone, so a jump back to The Gate would rightly switch the entry OFF) writes it for real: the server holds it ON and nothing new is journaled. The toggle is a file write only in file gating mode (scan mode, the default, gates per scan and writes nothing here), so the check switches to file mode first and cleanup puts the mode back; since v2.8 69 K12 (5c086027) the whole-book save goes through the story-orchestrator-lore plugin's commit route when the plugin is installed, and falls back to ST's save (the unread `/api/worldinfo/edit`) when it is not. V17 is about that unread answer, so the fault step answers the commit route 404 (the plugin-less host, on any install) and `/api/worldinfo/edit` 500; a refused commit is K12's own check (v28-69-k12-*). Cleanup: `so-assets.mts remove --marker SO-V17` deletes the book and deselects it.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const G = globalThis.storyOrchestratorScanGating; if (!G) throw new Error('the lorebook gating is not installed'); const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator'].settings; globalThis.__v17WorldInfo = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(root.worldInfo ?? {})); if (rt.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.gatingMode !== 'file') await G.requestFile(); const now = rt.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.gatingMode; if (now !== 'file') throw new Error(`the checkpoint toggle writes the lorebook file only in file gating mode, and the mode is ${now}`); return { was: globalThis.__v17WorldInfo.gatingMode ?? null, now };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const made = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'createStoryLorebook', name: 'SO-V17 Lore' }, { requirements: { lorebooks: [] } }); if (!made.ok && !made.message.includes('already exists')) throw new Error(`could not create the lorebook: ${made.message}`); const entry = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'upsertLorebookEntry', lorebook: 'SO-V17 Lore', comment: 'The ferry', keys: ['ferry'], content: 'The ferry runs at dawn.', constant: false }, { requirements: { lorebooks: ['SO-V17 Lore'] } }); if (!entry.ok) throw new Error(`could not write the entry: ${entry.message}`); return { lorebook: made.message, entry: entry.message };

import_story.title: SO-V17 Readback
import_story.description: A second checkpoint that switches a lorebook entry on.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); globalThis.__v17Flag = async () => { const response = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'SO-V17 Lore' }), cache: 'no-cache' }); const data = await response.json(); const hit = Object.values(data.entries ?? {}).find((row) => row.comment === 'The ferry'); if (!hit) throw new Error('the server copy has no "The ferry" entry'); return hit.disable; }; globalThis.__v17Refusals = () => JSON.stringify(globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSessionJournal()).split('world_info effect could not be applied').length - 1; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000)); return { atGateDisabled: await globalThis.__v17Flag(), refusals: globalThis.__v17Refusals() };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const before = globalThis.__v17Refusals(); const original = globalThis.fetch; let refused = 0; let bypassed = 0; globalThis.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input?.url ?? ''; if (url.includes('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-lore/commit')) { bypassed += 1; return new Response('not found', { status: 404 }); } if (url.includes('/api/worldinfo/edit')) { refused += 1; return new Response('refused by the V17 check', { status: 500 }); } return original(input, init); }; try { await rt.activateCheckpoint('quay'); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500)); } finally { globalThis.fetch = original; } const disabled = await globalThis.__v17Flag(); const refusals = globalThis.__v17Refusals(); const journal = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => JSON.stringify(event).includes('world_info effect could not be applied')); if (refused === 0) throw new Error('no lorebook save was attempted, so the refusal was never exercised'); if (disabled !== true) throw new Error(`the injected 500 should have left the server's flag OFF, and it reads disable=${disabled}`); if (refusals <= before) throw new Error(`the server refused the save (${refused} request(s) answered 500) and nothing was journaled`); if (!JSON.stringify(journal).includes('The ferry')) throw new Error(`the journal entry does not name the entry: ${JSON.stringify(journal)}`); const cached = Object.values((await SillyTavern.getContext().loadWorldInfo('SO-V17 Lore'))?.entries ?? {}).find((row) => row.comment === 'The ferry'); if (cached?.disable !== true) throw new Error(`the page's copy of the book disagrees with the server after the lost write: disable=${cached?.disable}`); globalThis.__v17AfterFault = refusals; return { refusedRequests: refused, commitRouteAnswered404: bypassed, serverDisable: disabled, pageDisable: cached.disable, journal: journal.slice(-1) };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const before = globalThis.__v17AfterFault; await rt.activateCheckpoint('quay'); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500)); const disabled = await globalThis.__v17Flag(); const refusals = globalThis.__v17Refusals(); if (disabled !== false) throw new Error(`re-entering The Quay should switch the entry ON on the server, and it reads disable=${disabled}`); if (refusals !== before) throw new Error(`a kept write was journaled as refused (${before} -> ${refusals})`); return { disabled, refusals };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const root = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator'].settings; const was = globalThis.__v17WorldInfo; delete globalThis.__v17WorldInfo; if (!was) return { restored: false }; const next = { ...root.worldInfo }; for (const key of ['gatingMode', 'gatingChosen']) { if (was[key] === undefined) delete next[key]; else next[key] = was[key]; } root.worldInfo = next; ctx.saveSettingsDebounced(); await globalThis.storyOrchestratorScanGating?.sync(); return { restored: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.gatingMode };
